basis: Account and survey collection in the production app: names, email, account and resident identifiers, demographics, household address, phone, geolocation, resident photos, health/vitals/medical forms, and custom survey answers. Processing is for providing the service; organizational access follows the surveyor's organization and consent flow. Service-provider processing and user-initiated survey submission are excluded from Google's sharing definition. Records are retained rather than processed ephemerally. No advertising, tracking, personalization, or independent security-audit claim is made.
